title: Vigil edge policy bundle v1
description: The signed document an edge daemon enforces while partitioned (design spec art_CRPCjz0X). Signing it is the human promotion of edge autonomy: the bundle selects from the tiers fixed in code and can never widen them. tier3+ is deliberately absent from the autonomy_tier enum — the signer refuses it, and the edge gate rejects any bundle claiming it. This schema is the cross-service wire contract: the daemon (services/edge) validates against it without importing core.

bundle_id.description: Stable identifier of the policy stream; versions of one stream share it.

edge_schema_version.description: Wire schema version; bump on incompatible change. A daemon older than the schema it is handed must demote to Tier 0.

segment_scope.description: What this bundle governs: a VPC, CIDR range, or node selector. A daemon applies the bundle only if its own identity fits this scope.

version.description: Strictly increasing per bundle_id. A daemon never accepts an older version over a newer one.

parent_version.description: Version this bundle supersedes; rollback-resistance help (TUF-style). Optional for v1.

expires_at.description: Hard validity end. An expired bundle can never be extended locally; the daemon demotes to Tier 0.

min_edge_version.description: Minimum daemon version that may run this bundle (semver).

autonomy_tier.description: Which autonomy band the daemon may operate in. tier0 observe-only, tier1 exact-IOC prevention, tier2 reversible network containment. tier3+ exist in the daemon enum but are unsignable in v1.

decision.description: Confidence bands and caps. The daemon's deterministic gate reads them from here, never from environment.

allowed_actions.description: The complete action vocabulary this bundle grants. Anything not listed never executes. Empty list = valid observe-only bundle (tier0).

action_type.description: v1 is network-scoped only: no host isolation, no file quarantine, no user disable.

executor.description: Which executor implementation may carry the action.

max_ttl_seconds.description: Upper bound on any single action's TTL; the daemon clamps to it.

namespaces.description: k8s_networkpolicy executor only: namespaces this bundle may write NetworkPolicy objects in.

rules.description: Deterministic rules: observations matching them act at their own severity floor without needing the SLM.

match.description: Free-form match document; the edge gate (services/edge) owns its semantics.

ioc_sets.description: Named IOC collections the rules reference. tier1 acts only on exact members of these sets.

revocations.description: Explicit revocation entries: named IOCs or rule_ids to stop honoring. Revocation beats local allowance.

rollback_reference.description: The bundle this one replaces (bundle_id + version) for operator rollback paths.
